newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends up on weakening US dlr abroad.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends up on weakening US dlr abroad.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed slightly higher against its American counterpart on Thursday, reflecting the weakening U.S. dollar overseas, dealers said.
The local dollar ended at T$27.493 against Wednesday's T$27.498 close. Turnover through dealers was US$168 million.

"Other than the overseas U.S. dollar factor, I saw non-delivery forward buying (on U.S. dollars), but which was almost balanced by exporters' U.S. dollar supply," said one dealer. She expected the rate to remain stable in the near future. A T$27.485-27.495 range was seen for Friday
